baseline.device_evidence: six-app v0.3.10 matrix: Path, Random Dice 2 and RogueLegend regressed cleanly; Duck and Aniimo kept concrete runtime semantics but consumer resolution remained unresolved while method-ordered notification/state scans hit their caps; Dragon discovered the correct menu candidate but did not enter analyzer because manual selection was not completed

scope.fixed_rva_policy: verified exact-build/UUID/original-byte points remain isolated in profile generators and are prohibited from generic runtime recognizers

binary_evidence_before_0311.sample_role: algorithm validation only; sample names and sample RVAs are prohibited from generic recognizers
binary_evidence_before_0311.shared_block_pattern: observer block invoke is commonly materialized with ARM64 ADR and stored into a stack block with STP rather than only ADRP+ADD plus STR
binary_evidence_before_0311.consumer_chain: Feature action -> notification -> block observer -> first block invoke -> nested dispatch block -> captured callback
binary_evidence_before_0311.state_xref_finding: exact-state consumers can exist in C/helper/block functions outside the early Objective-C method scan window; therefore absence from the old 512-method scan is not evidence of absence

block_observer_invoke.promotion: resolved only when the bounded stack-stored executable candidate is unique; ambiguous candidates remain diagnostic

notification_prefilter.strategy: locate Objective-C observer selector refs in __objc_selrefs, scan selected-image __text for exact selector-ref xrefs, map only those PCs to candidate owning methods, then run HFA5MScanMethod on the reduced set
notification_prefilter.reason: replace ordered first-N method scanning rather than increase its budget

full_text_state_xref.strategy: linearly scan selected-image __text for exact backend/helper state address materialization before semantic analysis
full_text_state_xref.semantic_analysis: only recovered candidate functions are analyzed
full_text_state_xref.candidate_policy: full-text xref alone is diagnostic and cannot promote a Feature binding

consumer_graph.nested_block_detection: bounded executable-pointer-to-stack scan within resolved callbacks

primary_device_matrix.dragon_test_requirement: manually select the discovered menu dylib candidate before running the analyzer if the UI still reports manualSelectionRequired

success_gates_for_0311: RogueLegend preserves Damage->FMUL, Defence->FDIV and God Mode->FCSEL
Random Dice 2 preserves DmgMulti/SPGain bindings and MergeAny branch outcome
Path of Kings preserves Damage/Defence/God Mode bindings and imports existing dictionary-block callback evidence into the v0.3.11 consumer graph
Duck and Aniimo no longer depend on the ordered 320/512-method scan to discover notification/state consumers
ADR/STP observer blocks are surfaced by V0311-BLOCK-INVOKE when present
Dragon full-text state xref reports exact-state candidates after the menu dylib is selected
No xref or nested-block candidate is promoted to a strong Feature binding without feature-specific exact-state evidence
next_task: Inject the v0.3.11 build into the six-app primary matrix. For Duck, Dragon and Aniimo inspect V0311-BLOCK-INVOKE, V0311-NOTIFY-XREF, V0311-STATE-XREF and V0311-CONSUMER-GRAPH. For Dragon complete manual menu selection first. Compare stable-app Feature/Branch/Outcome bindings against the v0.3.10 run.
